class.name: MaszynaLocale
class.brief_description: The game's own translation of the original engine's strings.
class.description: The original engine's [code]locale[/code] (translation.cpp): loads [code]<game_dir>/lang/<language>.po[/code], where the language is [member MaszynaRuntime.language], on start and whenever the game directory changes. Strings are looked up by their English msgid. The catalogue is kept apart from [TranslationServer]: it translates the original's strings, not this project's interface. The project's own strings follow the same language - [TranslationServer]'s locale is set to it.

method.name: get_languages
method.description: The languages there is a catalogue for in the game's [code]lang/[/code] ([code]template.po[/code] excepted), with [code]"en"[/code] - the untranslated strings - always first.

method.name: gettext
method.description: Returns the translation of [param msgid] from the game's catalogue, else from the wrapper's own strings ([TranslationServer], [code]addons/libmaszyna/translations[/code]), else [param msgid] itself.

method.name: load_translation
method.description: Replaces the catalogue with the one in [param po_path]. Without such a file every msgid stays untranslated.
